lines.text: The LORD tells Moses and Aaron to tell the Israelites that a man's bodily discharge is unclean.
Any clay pot the man touches must be broken, and when he is cleansed he counts seven days.
On the eighth day the cleansed man gives two turtledoves or two young pigeons to a Levite, who sacrifices them.
A woman with a flow of blood is unclean for forty days, and anyone touching her is unclean until evening.
The children of Israel must be kept separate from their uncleanness so they do not die by defiling the tabernacle.
